mapper.sql: inner join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'bss_user_relation_type' and d.status = '0' and d.dict_value = mur.mapping_type

select mur.id, mur.user_name as "userName", su.nick_name as "nickName", mur.mapping_id as "whCd", coalesce(mw.wh_nm, mur.mapping_name, mur.mapping_id) as "whNm", mur.mapping_type as "mappingType", mur.memo, mur.version from mast_user_relations mur
left join sys_user su on su.user_name = mur.user_name and su.del_flag = '0' left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = mur.mapping_id and mw.delete_flg = '0'
mapper.select:
where mur.delete_flg = '0'
and mur.mapping_id = #{whCd}
and ( mur.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or su.nick_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') )
order by su.nick_name, mur.user_name, mur.mapping_id, d.dict_sort
select user_name as "userName", nick_name as "nickName" from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by user_name
select wh_cd as "whCd", wh_nm as "whNm" from mast_warehouse where delete_flg = '0' order by wh_cd
select wh_cd as "whCd", wh_nm as "whNm" from mast_warehouse where delete_flg = '0' and wh_cd = #{whCd}
select count(1) from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into mast_user_relations ( id, user_name, mapping_type, mapping_id, mapping_name, seq, memo, delete_flg, create_time, create_by, create_pg_id, update_time, update_by, update_pg_id, version ) values ( #{id}, #{userName}, #{mappingType}, #{mappingId}, #{mappingName}, #{seq}, #{memo}, #{deleteFlg}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{createPgId}, #{updateTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updatePgId}, #{version} )
mapper.update: update mast_user_relations set delete_flg = '1', update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and delete_flg = '0'
